industry: Nanowire-based biosensors and molecular detection technology
summary: Företag 13 develops nanowire-based sensing platforms for single-molecule detection, biomarker analysis and next-generation nucleic acid sequencing. The company commercializes nanotechnology for diagnostics, life sciences and precision medicine applications.
target_market: Global diagnostics, genomics and life science research market
strategy_notes: Focused on commercializing nanowire-based sensing platforms and advancing next-generation sequencing and biomarker detection applications through collaborations and licensing opportunities.
technology_notes: Uses proprietary nanowire fabrication, alignment and functionalization technologies to enable highly sensitive optical, electrochemical and electrical biosensing, including single-molecule detection.
risk_notes: Dependent on successful commercialization, regulatory acceptance in healthcare-related markets, customer adoption, funding availability and competition from established genomics and diagnostics technology providers.
